title: wsteth-2.0 chain config
description: Per-chain config for the vendored CCIP deploy. Each field is L (external/definitional fact), D (authored governance commitment), or E (generated work-effect). A committed template carries only L+D; the deploy writes E (addresses.token, governance_addresses.lido_dao_agent, deployed, ccv) in place. Used by `just lint-config`. See config/README.md.

token.description: E — deployed token (L1 Lido wstETH / L2 BurnMintERC20Bridged). Empty in a template; written by step 01/03.

ccip.description: L — external CCIP facts for this chain (Chainlink-fixed). Committed; FFI-refreshable by 1_Deploy.

pool_type.description: L — L1 hub = SiloedLockRelease; L2 spoke = BurnMint.

governance_addresses.description: Mixed quadrant: emergency_brakes/chainlink_mcms = D (authored role intent); guardian is a legacy vendor-schema field unused by the current POM; lido_dao_agent/deployer = E (observed deploy outputs). Splitting the E fields into the record is a recommended follow-up (review R3).

guardian.description: Legacy compatibility field — current PoolOperationManager has no GUARDIAN_ROLE and 1_Deploy does not consume this value.

lido_dao_agent.description: E — deployed L1 Agent / L2 OpExec (gets POM DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE). Zero in a template; written by step 01/02.

deployer.description: D->E — authored placeholder; step 04 stamps the observed signing key (whose admin role step 07 revokes).

remote_lanes.description: D — authored lane topology. step 04 re-points the L1 hub's lane to the active L2_CHAIN.

deployed.description: E — written by 1_Deploy; absent in a pristine template.

ccv.description: E — written by 1_Deploy; absent in a pristine template.
